messages:
Maya (People Ops): Heads-up: Product org split next quarter. Serena will run the new Product Platform org focused on SDKs, client integrations, and developer tooling. Diego will keep core Product for feature and roadmap. Were opening an internal window for a Sr PM (L5) to join Product Platform. Apply by Apr 18.

Diego (VP Product): This split reduces manager span and gives platform owners direct escalation. Expect a 2-week overlap for transition.

Serena (Head of Product Platform): Excited to get started. Priority is to stabilize the SDK release cadence and a small reorg of PM wrt platform vs feature owners. Will publish job scope by EOD.

Lina (Talent): Internal application link: <https://company.internal/hiring/sr-pm-platform>. Internal window closes Apr 18. Panel will include Eng Platform, Product, and DevEx.

Omar (Eng Manager - Platform): Quick ask: will platform PMs sit with Eng Platform or remain in core Product? We should lock reporting to avoid split priorities.

Serena (Head of Product Platform): Platform PMs will be aligned to Product Platform (co-located team) but maintain regular syncs with feature PMs. We'll publish RACI for Q2.

Zoe (SRE): Offer to be a tech interviewer for the hiring panel. Also can share the incident backlog that impacts SDK reliability.

Maya (People Ops): Action items:
- Lina: open internal L5 PM window (due Apr 18)
- Serena: post job scope + RACI (by Apr 8)
- Omar & Zoe: nominate interviewers (by Apr 10)
- People Ops: update org chart and run onboarding checklist for the new PM

Anita (People Ops Bot): Calendar events created: "Product Platform intro" (May 6) and "Sr PM hiring panel" (Apr 20).

Maya (People Ops): If youre interested or want to nominate someone internally, DM Lina. Please react with :rocket: if you saw this.
